title: Turning my AI short film THE WINDOW into a horror game prototype - COLD OUT THERE: THE REFUGE (early WIP)
author: Acceptable-Day5621
selftext:
I make AI short films, and I'm now trying to turn two of them (THE WINDOW and MIND THE GAP) into a small first-person winter horror game. This clip is prototype footage, very much work in progress.

  
How AI fits in:

\- The short film footage (the opening shots in the clip) was generated with Seedance 2.5.

\- The game itself: built by combining several AI models (Opus 5.5, ChatGPT 6.1, Sol and Grok).

  
No release date, platforms or price yet. It's a prototype. I'd love input from people who've mixed AI film footage with real-time gameplay: did you lean into the contrast, or try to hide it?
